verdict.rationale: The product documents part of this story. Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated through the API, cases can be filtered by risk, stage, assignee and date, and a case audit trail and decision options exist. The OpenAPI schema covers case resources, so an agent can pull flagged cases with context. The first-party agentic workflows also auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases to humans. However, no documented capability produces evidence summaries or recommends a decision that is held for a human to confirm, and the agent offerings are described only briefly in marketing material. Missing for 10: documented summarize-and-recommend output for human confirmation, detail on how the screening agents present reasoning to reviewers, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent queue triage.
